items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 42:1
items.html: (To the question) Because its vessel, which is the upper third of Tifferet, fell only to the aspect of the chest and below, it therefore did not need to descend at all, since it remained attached to it from its place, in the aspect of crowns upon it. (p. 557, Item 28)
